title: One line: what this experiment is
hypothesis: What you expect to see, stated so that the decision rule below can contradict it.

config.note: Everything run.ts is parameterised by goes here. run.ts reads it; it has no constants of its own.

decisionRule.text: Pass if <primaryMetric> is at least <threshold> in at least <k> of <n> seeds. Written so it can be applied without reading run.ts.

onFail: What a fail changes in the research plan. If nothing would change, do not run the card.
